title: Add schema migration system to fieldwork::db
description:
fieldwork::db currently uses CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS which only works for fresh databases. The three consumer projects have live data that needs to be migrated to the canonical schema.

Need a migration system that:
1. Tracks schema version (schema_meta table with version integer)
2. Runs versioned migration functions in order
3. Each migration is idempotent (safe to re-run)
4. Wraps each migration in a transaction (rollback on failure)

Migration list for v0 -> v1 (canonical):
- Gaja: mostly column renames and timestamp conversion (TIMESTAMPTZ -> INTEGER Unix seconds). Lightest migration.
- Smallhold: split accounts into users+personas, rename account_id -> persona_id everywhere, add user_id columns, convert timestamps if needed.
- Broadside: add users table, add user_id to personas, replace inline follower fields with remote_accounts FK, convert TEXT timestamps to INTEGER, add many missing tables.

Implementation:
- fieldwork::db::migrate() checks current version and runs pending migrations
- Migration functions are registered in a Vec<Migration> with version number and async fn
- Each project can also register project-specific migrations (e.g. broadside feed_state)
- Schema version stored in: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS schema_version (version INTEGER NOT NULL)

The CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS approach stays as the 'from scratch' path. The migration system handles 'from existing data' path. migrate() detects which path by checking if schema_version table exists.
close_reason: Migration system implemented: version tracking, incremental migrations, legacy schema detection, project-specific extras via migrate_with(). First migration (v1) adds did:scid columns. 9 new tests.
